text:
Alex: Heads-up — prepping the partner playbook for the upcoming QBR cycle. Focus: credits runway, tier reset thresholds for SIs, and marketplace attribution. Kickoff Thurs 10am PT? Agenda: scorecard refresh, MDF cadence, gating thresholds, joint announcement checklist.
Mina: Thurs works for finance. Can you circulate current MDF committed vs spend? I can bring a 3-quarter rolling forecast.
Sam: Product ok. Please add 'joint announcement readiness checklist' — some marketplace partners need 6–8 week runway for co-ordinated launches.
Jordan: Agree on gating thresholds. Proposed soft gate = activation within 90d + 50% of committed pipeline. I'll share a draft threshold matrix.
Rita: Suggest a fallback credit buffer for HW partners — 10% shared pool to cover provisioning delays. Pinging @infra to validate capacity impact.
Alex: @Rita good call. @Sam please drop a checklist template. I'll open the playbook PR today and link it here.
Mina: Finance prefers monthly snapshots + a rolling 90-day runway column. Sharing sheet: https://docs.company.com/sheets/partner-mdf-runway
Sam: Draft checklist and meeting notes uploaded: https://git.company/partnerships/qbr-playbook/draft1
Jordan: One ask — how do we map cross-cloud marketplace credits vs direct MDF in scorecards? Need explicit attribution fields.
Alex: Proposal: add three columns in scorecard — marketplace_credits, mdf_direct, co_marketing — plus 'recon owner' to avoid double-counting.
Rita: Uploaded sample split file `BudgetSplit_v2.csv` to the shared dropbox. Also recommend adding 'credit reconciliation owner' field and 'notification cadence'.
Mina: Will RACI the flows this week. Can someone loop in Sales Ops for attribution confirmation? @Sam can you add Carmen?
Sam: Added @carmen (sales-ops) to the invite. Carmen, can you confirm attribution rules before Thurs?
Carmen: happy to help. I'll validate offline and bring a short handoff doc to the meeting.
Deploy-bot: Reminder — RSVP for "Partner Playbook: QBR & Credit Runway" invite sent by Alex. :calendar:
Alex: Meeting invite updated with agenda + pre-reads. Thanks all — if you have hard blockers DM me. :thumbsup:
